context:
Goal: the guards for artifact tools also fire when a Mac session writes your page.
Problem (goal): the guard finds your page only by the page link in the call, and nobody knows whether a Mac page write or publish carries that link, so the lane needs two real calls from your Mac.
Based on (read): the guard reads the link from the call's url field (hooks/question_form.py, waiting_page_root); the Mac call shapes recorded on Nov 8 name no url.
Departs from: main — adds guarding for Mac artifact calls, which today go unchecked.
Why yours: cloud sessions have no Mac artifact tools and cannot reach a Mac session (measured 2026-11-12, the lane found no such tool in its session and no reachable Mac session).
home: step artifact-guard-matcher-names (artifact guards fire on every tool name)

options.gain: The Mac guards are built on real call shapes.
options.how: In a Claude session on your Mac, ask it to show the raw input of one page database write and one file publish it makes, and say whether the server accepts a path with a leading slash, a capital letter, or a file path inside an operation, and whether a batch with one bad operation writes nothing. Paste the answer into the lane's session.
options.label: Paste the two calls
options.lose: A few minutes on your Mac.

options.how: The lane builds the rest; Mac calls with no page link stay unguarded.
options.label: Skip it
options.lose: A Mac session can still write your page without the checks.

title: Paste one Mac page-write call and one Mac publish call for the artifact guards
why: Only a Mac session has these tools, and none is reachable from the cloud.
